summary: The plane class climb-angle solver 007D98F0 runs the image's own predicate, the trial integration 007D9360, instead of the labelled closed-form substitution. 007D9360 now seeds its record through 007D7C00 and integrates it through the 007D8470 path a fresh record takes (fold, 007D8611 step, body-to-world). The drag 007D9140 and thrust 007D9050, previously host-inline code, are each one callable body in src/plane_flight.cpp; the live flight law (run_core_law_007db680) and the trial both call them. The flight-law ON arms are bit-identical to the old inline arms (2,000,000 random cases each in a throwaway PC24 probe).
evidence: 007D98F0-007D99B6 listing: probe kept on the x87 stack, mid = float((high+low)*0.5), predicate 007D9360(mid, probe, 0.04f, 10).z >= probe (JC sends less or unordered to high), loop while float(high-low) > the double DEG(0.01) (JA). Constants read from the PE: 00CF8858 = 3FB2B8C3, 00D06850 = 3F26E05A80000000, 00CE3910 = 0.04f.

007D9360 listing: record at ESP+78h (vtable 00D06844), +88h..+90h from 00F87574 (BSS zero), +A4h/+C4h = 0, +C0h/+C8h/+CCh = 0.0f, 007D7C00 at 007D94E5, 007D8470(record, dt, P, P^-1) at 007D9824, copy-back of +64h/+4Ch at 007D982C..007D987C; 007D9140 called with (speed, 1.0f, angle, 0, 0).

007D8470 listing: with those record values only the three folds + 0.001 deadband, the per-axis step 007D8611..007D87C2 and the world velocity 007D8C6B..007D8CF0 (((x+y)+z) per component, the 0042D0D0 arithmetic on P) are reached.

Throwaway probe at PC24 with F4F-like class values (Accel 7, MaxSpd 83.33, StallSpd 17.5): ON 0.419799 rad vs the substitution's 0.419798; two other classes 1.067310 vs 1.067477 and 0.218507 vs 0.218507; MaxSpd 0 gives 0 either way.
